nfpa_1001_vent.name: NFPA 1001 - Vertical Roof Ventilation
nfpa_1001_vent.objectives:
1. Demonstrate safe roof ladder placement.
2. Execute a proper rectangular ventilation cut.
3. Coordinate vertical venting with interior fire attack teams.
nfpa_1001_vent.safety: Full structural PPE with SCBA donned. Ensure 100% tie-off safety harness on pitched roofs. Check structural integrity with sounding tool before stepping onto roof surface.

nfpa_1001_forcible.name: NFPA 1001 - Forcible Entry Techniques
nfpa_1001_forcible.objectives:
1. Identify door construction types (inward vs outward swinging).
2. Properly gap, set, and force an inward-swinging door using irons.
3. Manage door control post-breaching.
nfpa_1001_forcible.safety: Safety glasses and leather gloves mandatory. Clear all bystanders from swing radius. Control tool leverage points to prevent slips.
